svg.title: Luca Garulli — ArcadeDB / Arcade Platform
svg.desc: Luca Garulli, creator of ArcadeDB. A diagram of an application talking to Arcade Platform (process engine, AI orchestration, auth and tenancy), which routes into ArcadeDB's multi-model engine: Graph, Document, Vector, Time Series and Key-Value.
svg.text: GRAPH · DOCUMENT · VECTOR · TIME SERIES · KEY-VALUE
